images.caption: Figure 2:SWE-Trail in two stages.Offline, the compiler reads the issue history, runs bounded read-only repository checks, and freezes an acquisition recordRiR_{i}containing a detectorDiD_{i}, a comparison objectiveuiu_{i}, and a sampling scheduleλi\lambda_{i}. Online, whenDiD_{i}identifies a state for additional collection effort, the coding agent proposes candidate next actions from its ordinary context. SWE-Trail briefly executes two candidates from the same checkpoint, and an identity-blind selector retains the route better supported by repository evidence underuiu_{i}. The coding agent then continues from the selected route. History never enters the coding agent’s context.
